why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft, game windows off by default

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Changed
- The game windows switch (Settings > Game windows) is OFF by default now. Turn it on to see the game's own windows in Persian.

New
- Floating report icon. A small icon with a counter. Every time WoWFA meets a text it can not translate yet, the green frame blinks once. Click it to copy the report and send it at wowfarsi.ir/report. Right click: open, settings, hide. Drag to move. It is off until the player says yes in a short one-time intro. The switch is also the first row of Settings > Status and report.
- Second report: Might of Stormwind, Spirit, Well Fed and Might of Stormwind descriptions, the Spell ID line and 'You are no longer rested.' are in Persian.
- Buff time left with the client's plural escape is translated and no longer noted as a miss.

Fixed
- Auction house: no English flash on every click. The auction house has its own switch on the game windows page.
- The 56 window texts of the first report.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.
